Amy — thanks for the details and the manifest. We're excited to run this. High-level answers below; can you confirm attendee arrival dates/times once you have them and whether any guests require visa letters?

1) Arrival windows: we prefer arrivals Dec 5 afternoon (after 2pm) for cross-team briefings and a full tech-rehearsal on Dec 6 AM. If your team prefers early morning arrivals we can accommodate on Dec 5.

2) Escort / local host: yes — Redwood will provide a dedicated on-site escort (Monica will be the point for arrival logistics) plus a mobile ops contact. We'll share Monica's cell and a second backup contact.

3) AV / footprint: for the executive day we'll need a single large room with podium + two breakout huddle areas. Ideally a 10x12ft stage area and 3x folding tables for kit. Can you confirm whether Rooms A/B can be combined or if there is an adjacent space for green room prep?

4) Access / security: we can pre-clear visitors if you share full legal names and DOBs for badges (attachable to the manifest). We'll follow your NDA sign-in flow.

I've looped Marissa to confirm venue mapping and coordinate transport corridors from the airport to your loading dock for equipment.

Next steps: Monica will send a draft local itinerary + calendar placeholders today; Marissa will share a one-page floorplan ask.

—Rishi
